label: def:antiderivative
title: Antiderivative
statement: We say that $F$ is an \emph{antiderivative} of $f$ on $(a,b)$ if $F$ is differentiable at every point $x \in (a,b)$ with $F'(x) = f(x)$, i.e.\ $\texttt{HasDerivAt}\; F\; (f\; x)\; x$ for all $x \in (a,b)$. The condition is vacuous when $a \ge b$.
